text:
maya: heads-up: since ~02:10 UTC we're seeing sustained p95 queue growth for hosted-usw2 small-gpu pool. dashboards show headroom oscillating rapidly and firing noisy alerts :grimacing:. https://grafana.re/redwood/d/abcd
sam: do we know if smoothing params changed in the dashboard or alert rule? last deploy was earlier today.
eli: ops-bot posted autoscaler events around 02:05: scale_down_blocked for 14m, then several pending pods. could be refill lag.
ops-bot: AUTOSCALER: scale_down_blocked pool=hosted-usw2-small duration=840s reason=insufficient_capacity
rafaela: I'm looking at the metric noise — the alert uses `avg_over_time(headroom_ratio[1m]) < 0.12` which follows spikes. recommend switching to `median_over_time(headroom_ratio[5m])` or `quantile_over_time(0.8, headroom_ratio[5m])`
devon: agree. also think admission controller throttle kicks in too aggressively when batch sizes spike. can we temp bump alert threshold and open a follow-up to tune admission?
maya: can someone run this query and paste p95 queue and refill latency for the last 30m? ```sum(rate(queue_length{pool=\"hosted-usw2-small\"}[1m])) by (pool)
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(refill_latency_bucket[5m])) by (le,pool))``` 
sam: p95 queue is ~48s at peak, refill latency peaked at 118s around 02:06. looks like control plane retry storm + network jitter
eli: I've opened ENGINFRA-3247 to track: 'review headroom smoothing + admission threshold, quick revert to median if noisy'. assigning to me + rafaela. temp change: set alert to 3m median and raise thres to 8% for 30m window.
rafaela: :thumbsup: I'll push the alert change and monitor. If queues don't drop in 15m we'll trigger canary throttling policy to fallback to larger instance types for new requests.
devon: FYI cost impact minimal for 30m but file an ops ticket if we breach weekly spend forecast.
maya: thanks all. keeping thread pinned. if anyone sees odd routing fallbacks, ping me @maya.
